3. However, chart_analyzer also explicitly reports for frames 101.0s/102.0s/103.0s that "No time axis or time values are visible, so time intervals cannot be read from this diagram alone," and OCR likewise only reads the position labels and does not read any "3 s" time value.

5. Therefore, from the available tool evidence, the velocity of the car cannot be determined from these frames, so the original answer 5 m/s is unsupported.
